cohort: The study included 100 individuals aged 6 to 16 years with complete orthodontic files and no congenital syndromes or pathologies, divided into 50 subjects with mandibular asymmetry and 50 subjects without.
finding: Male gender, oral ventilation, short-term vaginal nasalization, dental trauma, and visual disorders were identified as factors associated with mandibular asymmetry.
mod_finding: Short-term vaginal nasalization was associated with mandibular asymmetry, whereas caesarean section was not considered an associated factor.
